description: This source file provides a utility function for resolving URLs, specifically handling certain auth-related endpoints to route them to an external domain while leaving others to use the provided base URL. It focuses on pattern matching for specific API paths and assembling the correct URL accordingly.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Resolves the full URL for authentication-related API endpoints, overriding specific paths to route requests to an external domain for consistency in auth flows.
